summary: Diff implements a combined camera+microphone permission request on Go Live preview mount and shows explicit denial messaging in the preview area. LivePage changes ensure the preview mounts when the start form is shown (including via ?startLive=1). One potential gap is that the cleanup code may not reliably stop the stored preflight stream due to React effect closure behavior, though the preview stopCamera() call likely handles the active preview tracks.

missing_requirements.requirement: If the user closes the start form or navigates away, any active media tracks created for the preview are stopped and the device indicator turns off (no camera/mic left running).
missing_requirements.reason: LiveCameraPreview attempts cleanup, but the effect has an empty dependency array while referencing preflightStream state in the cleanup function. This risks the cleanup capturing the initial null value and not stopping the preflight stream via preflightStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop()). (Preview tracks may still be stopped by stopCamera(), but the diff does not prove all tracks are reliably stopped in all cases.)
